clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, Hallowed Rune brings a young dwarf priest to Anvilmar. Sten Stoutarm carries Branstock Khalder’s inscribed prayers and guidance to the novice, who is summoned inside to deepen their bond with the Holy Light.

A young priest earns Sten Stoutarm’s notice while helping clear threats outside Anvilmar. Branstock Khalder, the settlement’s spiritual guide, gives Sten a rune inscribed with prayers and guidance for the novice. The young priest is called inside Anvilmar’s sturdy halls to begin sacred studies.

Dwarven life prizes martial strength and heavy plate, yet the Holy Light remains central to Ironforge society. In Coldridge Valley, holy casters stand with warriors and hunters to protect the enclave from trogg incursions and dangerous wildlife moving through the snow.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ach! Ya made it, friend! Wonderful!
I was gonna say, I was about to lose faith that ye'd arrive at all... Get it, lose faith? It's a joke, lass... Aww, nevermind. Ya didn't come here for me bad jokes anyway.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm the one who can train ya as you start to find your way around Coldridge Valley. When ya feel yer ready, come back to me and we'll see about maybe teaching you a new spell or two to fend off the valley from them blasted troggs.
Ya got the Light on yer side, along with all of Ironforge, friend... No pressure on ya to become somethin' special.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
